title.zh: 分子氢四族碰撞矩阵组装

summary: From an explicit cylindrical velocity-space carrier (vr, vx, Vr2pidVr, dVx) and the thermal normalization (Tnorm, mu), assemble the four (nvr*nvx, nvr*nvx) molecular H2 SIG collision matrices (CX, H2-H, H2-P, H2-H2) via the double-velocity-space predecessor geometry, the embedded theta five-point quadrature and Fortran-order reshapes.

identity.relation: SIG_fam = F^-1(W * (S_fam @ D_THETA)) per family, where S_fam[:,:,m] carries v_v*sigma_fam(E) (with the family's vr2_vx2/vx_vx factor and constants) evaluated on the (nvr,nvx,nvr,nvx,ntheta) predecessor geometry, W = Vr2pidVrdVx (times vx_vx for the H2-H/H2-P elastic families), and F/F^-1 are the source's legacy Fortran-order flatten/restore between the (nvr,nvx,nvr,nvx) kernel and the (N,N) matrix (N = nvr*nvx).
identity.direction: velocity-space carrier (vr, vx, Vr2pidVr, dVx) + thermal normalization (Tnorm, mu) -> four assembled molecular SIG collision matrices (SIG_CX, SIG_H2_H, SIG_H2_P, SIG_H2_H2)
identity.definition: The saved source's four-family SIG kernel assembly (kinetic_h2.py:1036-1125): a double-velocity-space (vr,vx) x (vr',vx') kernel over a five-point theta quadrature; each family multiplies v_v (relative speed) by its cross-section fit evaluated at E = v_v2 * (energy factor), applies the signed vr2_vx2 / vx_vx factors and constants (SIG_H2_H2: vr2_vx2 factor and /8 with the source's vis=1 call, both branches sharing one coefficient set), contracts over theta, applies the Vr2pidVrdVx weight, and restores to the (N,N) matrix in Fortran order. Energy factors (source verbatim): SIG_CX uses H_MASS*Vth2/Q (no 0.5, no mu; kinetic_h2.py:1045) -- not the atomic-side convention; SIG_H2_H/SIG_H2_P use 0.5*H_MASS*Vth2/Q; SIG_H2_H2 uses H_MASS*mu*Vth2/Q.
identity.model: the saved formal implementation, ported with its geometry, quadrature and reshapes verbatim and its cross-section fits reused from the integrated scirel.collisions leaves (see provenance and verification for the exact parity statement)
identity.geometry: per call: the full (nvr,nvx) x (nvr,nvx) double-velocity-space kernel over ntheta=5 quadrature points, Fortran-order flattened to (N,N) matrices with N = nvr*nvx
identity.coordinates: cylindrical (vr,vx) velocity space, v/vth normalized; Vr2pidVr and dVx in the source's discrete velocity-space measure; Tnorm in eV; the callable performs no implicit unit conversion
identity.boundary: finite aligned inputs of the declared shapes; vr entries must be positive and vx strictly increasing with at least one positive and one negative entry (no monotonicity gate on vr, no exact-symmetry gate on vx); Vr2pidVr nonnegative, dVx positive, Tnorm and mu positive; bounded negative cells in the three elastic families (intrinsic to the signed vx_vx / vr2_vx2 factors) are reproduced as-is, never clamped
assumptions: The carrier (vr, vx, Vr2pidVr, dVx) arrives already built (source make_dvr_dvx outputs); this operator performs no gridding.
The cross-section fits are the saved KN1DPy sigma/ slices; the port evaluates them through the integrated scirel.collisions leaves instead of a second embedded copy.
Bounded negative cells inherited from the signed elastic factors are reproduced as-is; whether they correspond to physically acceptable diffusion behavior is left to expert review.
No external atomic-physics reference is bound: the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.

inputs.name: vr
inputs.description: Radial velocity axis v/vth on the cylindrical mesh; the source make_dvr_dvx output axis.
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D with at least one entry; every entry positive (rejected otherwise). No monotonicity gate is applied.

inputs.name: vx
inputs.description: Axial velocity axis v/vth on the cylindrical mesh; the source make_dvr_dvx output axis.
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D, strictly increasing, containing at least one positive and one negative entry.

inputs.name: Vr2pidVr
inputs.description: Cylindrical radial finite-volume integration weight (source make_dvr_dvx output).
inputs.units: source-discrete velocity-space measure; no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D of size nvr; entries nonnegative.

inputs.name: dVx
inputs.units: source-discrete velocity-space measure; no implicit conversion
inputs.constraints: Finite 1-D of size nvx; entries positive.

inputs.name: Tnorm
inputs.description: Thermal normalization temperature; Vth = sqrt(2*Q*Tnorm/(mu*H_MASS)) with Q = 1.602177e-19 J/eV and H_MASS = 1.6726231e-27 kg (the same eV convention as the integrated thermal-speed-scale relation).
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive; must be a true scalar (0-d). Size-1 arrays are rejected -- a port-added fail-closed tightening: the saved arm accepts a size-1 array Tnorm and would produce a (1,1) Vth2 field instead of the declared length-1.

inputs.name: mu
inputs.description: Normalized mass flag entering the SIG_H2_H2 energy factor and Vth (source: 1 = hydrogen, 2 = deuterium).
inputs.constraints: Finite and positive; must be a true scalar (0-d). Size-1 arrays are rejected -- a port-added fail-closed tightening: the saved arm accepts a size-1 array Tnorm and would produce a (1,1) Vth2 field instead of the declared length-1.

outputs.name: SIG_CX
outputs.description: H2 + H2+ charge-exchange collision matrix: v_v * sigma_cx_hh(v_v2 * H_MASS*Vth2/Q) contracted over the five-point theta quadrature with the Vr2pidVrdVx weight.
outputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure (cross section x relative speed x velocity-space weight); no implicit conversion
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); nonnegative on the declared domain; never clamped.

outputs.name: SIG_H2_H
outputs.description: H2-H elastic collision matrix: v_v * sigma_el_h_hh(v_v2 * 0.5*H_MASS*Vth2/Q) contracted over theta with the Vr2pidVrdVx * vx_vx weight.
outputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure; no implicit conversion
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); contains bounded negative cells from the signed vx_vx factor, reproduced as-is.

outputs.name: SIG_H2_P
outputs.description: H2-H+ elastic collision matrix: v_v * sigma_el_p_hh(v_v2 * 0.5*H_MASS*Vth2/Q) contracted over theta with the Vr2pidVrdVx * vx_vx weight.
outputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure; no implicit conversion
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); contains bounded negative cells from the signed vx_vx factor, reproduced as-is.

outputs.name: SIG_H2_H2
outputs.description: H2-H2 elastic (viscosity, source vis=1 with both branches sharing one coefficient set) collision matrix: vr2_vx2 * v_v * sigma_el_hh_hh(v_v2 * H_MASS*mu*Vth2/Q) / 8 contracted over theta with the Vr2pidVrdVx weight.
outputs.units: source-discrete assembled collision-matrix measure; no implicit conversion
outputs.constraints: Finite (fail closed otherwise); contains bounded negative cells from the signed vr2_vx2 factor, reproduced as-is.

outputs.name: forensic_state
outputs.description: Captured predecessor geometry and thermal normalization returned by the saved formal implementation for forensic parity checks: v_v2, v_v, vr2_vx2 (shapes (nvr,nvx,nvr,nvx,ntheta)), vx_vx, Vr2pidVrdVx (shapes (nvr,nvx,nvr,nvx)), and Vth2 (length-1 array).
outputs.shape: as listed; Vth2 is a length-1 array
outputs.constraints: Finite; bitwise part of the saved-arm replay comparison. These are captured-state forensic fields of the saved formal contract, not additional scientific products; they are returned in one dict alongside the SIG_* matrices under the listed key names.

preconditions: A finite aligned velocity-space carrier of the declared shapes exists (the source make_dvr_dvx outputs).
The caller supplies the thermal normalization; this operator performs no gridding, gating, or cache handling.
supported: Molecular four-family SIG collision-matrix assembly (SIG_CX, SIG_H2_H, SIG_H2_P, SIG_H2_H2) on an explicit velocity carrier.
excluded: The atomic four-family assembly, the SIG_D2_* and other collision families, Do_SIG_* gating, KH2.Internal cache lifecycle (the source's New_Grid=1/0 two states are bitwise identical for this mapping), the downstream Alpha contraction (N3-3), the Omega_H2_* aggregation (N3-4), the per-generation MH construction (N3-5), and external physical validation.

failure_semantics.invalid_input: Raises ValueError when any carrier argument is not 1-D of the declared size, when any entry is non-finite, when vr has a non-positive entry, when vx is not strictly increasing or lacks a positive or negative entry, when Vr2pidVr is negative or dVx is non-positive, or when Tnorm or mu is non-positive or non-finite.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Raises ValueError if any family matrix assembles to a non-finite value; no partial results are returned.

provenance.lineage_summary: Development integration from the saved KN1DPy 分子氢碰撞矩阵组装 package, source anchor KN1DPy/kinetic_h2.py:1036-1125, as recorded by the saved bundle's own provenance section. Saved implementation file SHA-256 34358f11e3ee91fa6768c8cf89d22eb1a2edbe2707f9e58d0b91472bf1b50d06. The predecessor geometry, theta quadrature, weights and Fortran-order reshapes are ported verbatim; the cross-section fits are reused from the integrated scirel.collisions leaves (coefficient- and clip-identical) instead of a second embedded copy. KN1DPy's strict D1 qualification has been withdrawn and the bundle sits in the re-review archive, so all of this is provisional bounded historical development comparison, not qualified-L1 provenance and not expert approval.
source_kinds: saved L1 operator document and implementation

example.description: Assemble the four molecular SIG matrices on a two-by-two canonical carrier and check the returned keys, shapes and SIG_CX nonnegativity.
example.expected: Four (4, 4) SIG matrices are returned; SIG_CX is nonnegative; a carrier length mismatch raises ValueError.

scope: Agreement with the saved KN1DPy implementation.
verification.evidence_ceiling: The maintained direct tests establish the four-family assembly against an independent broadcasting-geometry oracle built on the source's own embedded formulas (rtol=1e-12, the saved packages' budget), the captured predecessor state, SIG_CX nonnegativity, the bounded negative elastic cells, and the fail-closed carrier contracts. In the environment-gated replay the port agrees with the saved KN1DPy implementation bit for bit on the three elastic families and the captured predecessor state, while the charge-exchange family agrees within rtol=1e-14: the standardized scirel.collisions leaf evaluates np.exp where the source uses np.e **, a deviation measured as at most 2.21e-15 relative on a 200,011-point probe of the union of the declared fit domains (clip endpoints, the H-P 10 eV branch boundary and E = 0; a 1,000,001-point log-grid root-cause probe observes up to 17 double-precision ulp by np.spacing). That probe is sampled evidence, not a bound over the continuous domain. The replay is provisional historical development evidence, not qualified-L1 provenance. No test establishes the assembly against an external atomic-physics reference; the saved package records that residual as validation_oracle_gap.
known_limitations: The saved bundle sits in the re-review archive and KN1DPy's strict D1 qualification is withdrawn; the historical replay evidence cannot be upgraded to qualified-L1 provenance without a new strict freeze and independent review of the source project.

The saved molecular operator document's canonical negative-cell note (2/2/4) conflicts with the reproducible canonical computation (4/4/8) on the saved package test's own fixture; the saved document is kept verbatim and the cause is an open expert-review item.

Whether the molecular four-family SIG assembly needs an independent physical oracle (e.g. collision-operator moment conservation) and whether the atomic/molecular SIG_CX energy-factor difference needs a cross-path reconciliation are open expert questions recorded by the saved package.
Negative cells in the elastic families are reproduced as-is; their physical acceptability is an open expert question, not a runtime gate.
Public distribution licensing remains pending a human decision.
